workExperience.description:
Migrated the organization website from Webflow CRM to Next.js, reducing load time by 40% and improving maintainability.
edesigned the whole UI for better accessibility and readability, increasing visitor engagement by 30%.
Built a volunteer recruitment platform integrated with dynamic forms and submission tracking using React, Tailwind, and
MongoDB.
Led development of ”Flow State App”, a full-stack Pomodoro and meditation tool for children in Myanmar IDP camps; introduced task-linked focus cycles not supported by most productivity apps.
